verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Replit's web interface functions as a code editor for building projects (replit-comm-11: 'I use Repl.it web interface for programming... There's various bugs in the editor but it works well enough'), and docs note you can start building on web/desktop/mobile (replit-docs-30). However, the docs pack is dominated by AI-agent-driven generation/publishing workflows rather than explicit first-party documentation of manual source-code editing features (file tree, syntax highlighting, direct diff/edit) inside the builder. Missing for 10: first-party docs explicitly describing the code editor UI/manual-edit workflow, and independent corroboration beyond a single community comment noting editor bugs.
